legend: We wish to construct an electricity generation and transmission network in a cluster of N$$$N$$$ islands. To this end, we have calculated a cost p(x)$$$p(x)$$$ to (potentially) build a generating station on each island x$$$x$$$, as well as a cost c(x,y)$$$c(x,y)$$$ to build an energy transmission line between any two islands x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$. An island is connected to the grid if it has a generating station built on it, or if there is a sequence of power transmission lines connecting it to an island that has a generating station. Our goal is to connect all N$$$N$$$ islands to the grid, minimizing the total network construction cost.
input: The first line of the input contains an integer N$$$N$$$ which gives the number of islands in the cluster.

The next N$$$N$$$ lines of the input are sequences of N$$$N$$$ numbers that form an N$$$N$$$-by-N$$$N$$$ array A$$$A$$$, such that each diagonal entry A[x,x]$$$A[x,x]$$$ corresponds to the cost p(x)$$$p(x)$$$ to build generating station on island x$$$x$$$ (that is, ′A[x,x]=p(x)′$$$'A[x,x] = p(x)'$$$), while each non-diagonal entry A[x,y]$$$A[x,y]$$$ corresponds to the cost c(x,y)$$$c(x,y)$$$ to build an energy transmission line between two islands x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$ (that is, ′A[x,y]=c(x,y)′$$$'A[x,y] = c(x,y)'$$$).
output: A single integer that gives the total construction cost of the network.
